deviations.why: No loyalty model data exists; inventing stamps/rewards would be false.

deviations.what: Omitted catering cart rental section and 'Book a Cart' hero button
deviations.why: No booking flow/pricing data; required removal per contract.
No seasonal offerings data; would require inventing flavors and availability.

deviations.what: Replaced corporate footer links (Careers, Press, etc.) with simple footer containing brand, limited nav, and social links
deviations.why: Corporate links irrelevant for Greek small business; required removal.

deviations.what: Adjusted terracotta accent color from #E07A5F to #C45A3A
deviations.why: Original color failed WCAG contrast ratio (below 4.5:1) for white text; minimal correction to meet accessibility.

deviations.what: Changed builder section to generic process steps without prices, statistics, or specific claims
deviations.why: Original had 'Over 2,000 combinations' and pricing; we kept the four-step structure but removed all invented data.

deviations.what: Used d.services as flavor card content; if no services, section omitted
deviations.why: No specific flavor data available; business data adapted to original card layout.

notes: The template faithfully preserves the original composition: fixed sidebar navigation with hours, hero with decorative scoops, two-row marquee of service cards, four-step builder (generic), about/findus sections, and simplified footer. Mobile navigation implemented via pure CSS checkbox toggle to maintain server component constraints. All colors derived from spine variables defined on .root.
